title: 6.18.3 Lab: Shots that leave
description: The catapult fires and the list cleans itself up, however many stones you launch.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The catapult works. Fire ten stones and the count climbs for ever.

steps.title: Add the sweep
steps.instructions: Add the backwards delete-and-splice from the sub-build.

steps.title: Prove it
steps.instructions: Fire ten stones, wait: the count should fall back to 0 each time.
hints: A count that plateaus but never falls means the splice is missing.

requirements.title: Both removals
requirements.description: delete and splice in the same branch. Help: 6.18.1 (Reading: Out and gone)

requirements.title: Backwards
requirements.description: The loop runs from the end. Help: 6.18.1 (Reading: Out and gone)
